resources.string: Use a custom capture filename template
Save these preferences for the next capture. They do not rename existing files or change a capture already admitted. Disabled naming preserves OCC_UUID.
Tokens: {project}, {camera}, {scene}, {take}, {reel}, {date}, {time}. Template limit: 128 characters. Date and time use UTC; take numbers have at least four digits.

Every name keeps the full capture UUID and its file extension/role suffix. Spaces and non-portable editorial characters become underscores in names only. The human prefix is limited to 160 UTF-8 bytes; an empty prefix becomes untitled. Slate metadata is not rewritten.
Example only — current slate, fixed UTC instant 2 Jan 2026 03:04:05.006 and an example UUID. Actual captures use their admission instant and their own UUID.
Invalid template. Use only the listed tokens and no paths, controls, blank text or trailing spaces/dots. Invalid drafts are not saved.
